title: nageia blumei
intro: Nageia blumei, commonly known as the 'Kadupul tree' or 'Queen of the night', is a species of evergreen tree in the cypress family (Cupressaceae). This plant has been found to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of various diseases and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Nageia blumei include antioxidant, antifungal, and anti-cancer activities, which are attributed to its ability to scavenge free radicals and inhibit the growth of cancer cells. The bioactive constituents of Nageia blumei include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been isolated and characterized in various studies, contributing to its medicinal properties.
